verdict.rationale: Ollama's first-party claims say prompts are never tracked or trained on and that nothing run locally leaves the machine. That implies a privacy-by-default posture for local use rather than a telemetry opt-out. The evidence documents no actual opt-out mechanism, setting, or environment variable, and it does not cover usage analytics, update checks, or cloud-mode tracking. Missing for 10: a documented telemetry/usage-tracking opt-out control, clarity on what non-prompt data (if any) is collected, coverage of cloud-mode tracking, independent verification of the no-tracking claims.
